assertion.text: Erdős Problem #971: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $p(a,d)$ be the least prime congruent to $a\pmod{d}$. Does there exist a constant $c>0$ such that, for all large $d$,\[p(a,d) > (1+c)\phi(d)\log d\]for $\gg \phi(d)$ many values of $a$? Prize: no. OEIS: A226521. Tags: number theory.
